subject: the exact Hangul syllable 틈 as custom compact lettering
idea: The brand name itself becomes the icon; generous breathing gaps give the compact Hangul a relaxed rhythm.
construction: Render only the single intact syllable 틈 (U+D2C8) in its correct Korean syllable-block structure. Make it broad and sturdy, with open horizontal intervals, a clearly open lower rectangular counter, consistent optical stroke weight and small softened corners. Keep the upper consonant, medial horizontal vowel and lower consonant legible as one normal syllable; no detached decorative bars, invented ligatures, split jamo, Latin initials or extra symbols. Give the counter a subtly wider proportion as the only expressive move.
material: Flat drawn lettering with clean filled surfaces, no outline, texture or shadow.
small_size: The lower counter and horizontal separation must remain open at 32px; exact 틈 must still read.
reference: Use the general observed principle of shared curves and spacing, with no reference brand glyph copied.
difference: Lettering carries the identity rather than a pictorial metaphor.
risk: The model may alter the Korean character or collapse the horizontal intervals; inspect exact lettering rather than accepting an approximate symbol.
